brief: an original modern main battle tank converted into a mobile DJ sound system: low wide hull with six road wheels and rubber tracks, side skirts with built-in speaker grilles, the turret built around a twin turntable DJ deck with two large chrome-ringed speaker cones on each side, a roof LED light bar, a row of three square LED panels on the turret side showing a cyan equalizer bar, a yellow lightning bolt and a magenta star, a long cannon ending in a glowing cyan ring muzzle, matte black base paint covered in acid-green and cyan graffiti circuit-line camouflage with magenta paint splashes, subwoofer-port exhausts at the rear
